content: For static sites with heavy media (gifs/mp4/screenshots), Cloudflare Pages offers unlimited bandwidth on its free tier backed by a 300+ location CDN, making it the standout choice over Netlify/Vercel (both cap free tier at 100GB/month bandwidth) and GitHub Pages (1GB repo soft cap, 100GB/month bandwidth, no iframe-widget restrictions relevant here). All three (Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel) support drop-in git-based deploys of a vue-cli-service dist/ build with zero config changes.
